scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --base=./ && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.test: node --test tests/protocol.test.cjs tests/clip-stats.test.cjs tests/updates.test.cjs tests/media.test.cjs tests/blanca-state.test.cjs tests/surface-geometry.test.cjs tests/library.test.cjs tests/media-geometry.test.cjs
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.lint: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit false --rootDir src --outDir output/lint-renderer && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --outDir output/lint-electron && node scripts/lint.cjs
